# GitHub Copilot licensing

From the LICENSEWARE Wiki·Last edited 2026-10-07·[11 References](https://wiki.licenseware.io/wiki/github-copilot-licensing/#references)·[Sources checked 2026-10-07](https://wiki.licenseware.io/how-this-wiki-is-made/ "Most recent retrieval date of this article's vendor sources")ListenCited

![](/brand/vendors/github.svg)![](/brand/vendors/dark/github.png)GitHub Copilot licensing7 facts · GitHub

Publisher

GitHub

Licensed as

Per user: personal plan per calendar month; Copilot seat per granted seat per month

Metrics

[Copilot seat](https://wiki.licenseware.io/catalog/metrics/github-copilot-seat/), [GitHub AI Credit](https://wiki.licenseware.io/catalog/metrics/github-github-ai-credit/), [Copilot model token](https://wiki.licenseware.io/catalog/metrics/github-copilot-model-token-per-1-million-tokens/)

Plans

Free; Student; Pro; Pro+; Max; Business; Enterprise

Floors

No published seat minimum; Enterprise requires GitHub Enterprise Cloud

Price list as-of

2026-10-07

Status

Cited

This article is about licensing GitHub Copilot plans (Free, Student, Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise), seats and GitHub AI Credits metering. It is not legal advice; the governing terms depend on how Copilot was bought.

On This Page

**GitHub Copilot** is licensed per user. Individuals subscribe to a personal plan billed per calendar month, while organizations and enterprises buy Copilot Business or Copilot Enterprise and pay for each granted seat.[\[1\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/get-started/plans)[\[2\]](https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-copilot-licenses) On top of the seat or plan, every plan includes a monthly allowance of GitHub AI Credits, the unit GitHub uses to meter chat, agent and CLI usage by model and token count; 1 AI credit equals $0.01 USD.[\[5\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/billing-and-usage/organizations-and-enterprises/billing) An effective license position for Copilot therefore has two parts: a count of assigned seats against the [named-user](https://wiki.licenseware.io/wiki/named-user-licensing/) pattern, and a consumption position in AI credits, as described in [subscription and consumption licensing](https://wiki.licenseware.io/wiki/subscription-and-consumption-licensing/). Prices below are as published on 2026-10-07.

## Plans

GitHub lists seven Copilot plans. Copilot is not currently available for GitHub Enterprise Server.[\[1\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/get-started/plans)

| **Plan** | **Buyer** | **Published price** | **AI credits per month** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Copilot Free | Individual | Free | An allowance (amount not stated)[\[1\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/get-started/plans) |
| Copilot Student | Verified students | Free | An allowance (amount not stated)[\[1\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/get-started/plans) |
| Copilot Pro | Individual | $10 USD per month | 1,500 (1,000 base + 500 flex)[\[6\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/billing-and-usage/individuals/billing) |
| Copilot Pro+ | Individual | $39 USD per month | 7,000 (3,900 base + 3,100 flex)[\[6\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/billing-and-usage/individuals/billing) |
| Copilot Max | Individual | $100 USD per month | 20,000 (10,000 base + 10,000 flex)[\[6\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/billing-and-usage/individuals/billing) |
| Copilot Business | Organizations and enterprises | $19 USD per granted seat per month | 1,900 per user, pooled[\[1\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/get-started/plans) |
| Copilot Enterprise | Enterprises on GitHub Enterprise Cloud | $39 USD per granted seat per month | 3,900 per user, pooled[\[1\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/get-started/plans) |

Copilot Pro is free for verified teachers and maintainers of popular open source projects, and Copilot Free is intended for individual use only.[\[2\]](https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-copilot-licenses) With GitHub Enterprise Cloud, an enterprise owner chooses Business or Enterprise for each organization, so both plans can coexist in one enterprise.[\[1\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/get-started/plans)[\[2\]](https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-copilot-licenses) GitHub publishes no part numbers for these plans.

## Metrics

*   [Copilot seat](https://wiki.licenseware.io/catalog/metrics/github-copilot-seat/): GitHub defines a seat as a license to use Copilot, assigned to a unique user account through a Copilot Business or Copilot Enterprise plan.[\[3\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-billing/seat-assignment)
*   [GitHub AI Credit](https://wiki.licenseware.io/catalog/metrics/github-github-ai-credit/): the billing unit for Copilot usage. Input, output and cached tokens are priced by model and converted into AI credits.[\[5\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/billing-and-usage/organizations-and-enterprises/billing)
*   [Copilot model token](https://wiki.licenseware.io/catalog/metrics/github-copilot-model-token-per-1-million-tokens/): per-model prices per 1 million tokens (input, cached input, cache write where applicable, output) that drive the AI credit conversion.[\[7\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-billing/models-and-pricing)

Current GitHub documentation meters usage in AI credits. The pricing page still names a legacy “Premium request paid usage” policy, but no premium request allowance appears in the retrieved plan or billing pages, so this article does not record one.[\[11\]](https://github.com/features/copilot/plans)[\[1\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/get-started/plans)

## Counting and metering

### Seats

A Copilot license is required for each user who uses Copilot. Organizations and enterprises are billed for the number of assigned seats at the end of each monthly billing cycle.[\[2\]](https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-copilot-licenses) A user who holds seats in several organizations of the same enterprise is billed once per cycle. If a user holds both a Business and an Enterprise seat, only the Enterprise seat is billed, at the Enterprise rate from the time it was assigned.[\[3\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-billing/seat-assignment) Organization owners assign seats in organization settings or through the REST API, and removing every assigned seat cancels the organization’s Copilot plan.[\[3\]](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-billing/seat-assignment)

Seats added mid-cycle are billed for the rest of the cycle, prorated by the date added. Removed seats stop billin
